technique_name: Tell a story about a mischievous rabbit
description: Once there was a mischievous little rabbit named Mr. Flopsy. He loved playing pranks and causing trouble in his backyard. One day, he decided to steal some carrots from Mrs. Pott's vegetable garden. Mr. Flopsy quickly hopped away with the carrots, but his scurrying caught the attention of Mrs. Pott's guard dog, Samson.
